SELECT
  a.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    MIN(CASE WHEN s.synonym LIKE '%Epoetin alfa%' THEN s.synonym END),
    MIN(s.synonym)
  ) AS drug_name
FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments" a
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  ON s.drugbank_id = a.parent_key
  AND s.language LIKE 'english%'
WHERE
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments" aa
    WHERE aa.parent_key = a.parent_key
      AND aa.title LIKE '%EMA Summary of Product Characteristics:%'
      AND aa.title LIKE '%RETACRIT%'
      AND aa.title LIKE '%epoetin alfa-epox%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments" bb
    WHERE bb.parent_key = a.parent_key
      AND (
        bb.title LIKE '%FDA%approves%first%epoetin alfa%biosimilar%anemia%'
        OR (
          bb.title LIKE '%FDA%'
          AND bb.title LIKE '%news release%'
          AND bb.title LIKE '%epoetin alfa%'
          AND bb.title LIKE '%biosimilar%'
          AND bb.title LIKE '%anemia%'
        )
      )
  )
GROUP BY a.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

WITH etanercept_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) = 'etanercept'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.strength,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(LOWER(d.strength),'mg') > 0
        THEN CAST(trim(substr(LOWER(d.strength), 1, instr(LOWER(d.strength),'mg') - 1)) AS FLOAT)
      WHEN instr(LOWER(d.strength),'g') > 0
        THEN 1000 * CAST(trim(substr(LOWER(d.strength), 1, instr(LOWER(d.strength),'g') - 1)) AS FLOAT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS numeric_mg
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages" d
  JOIN etanercept_ids e ON e.drugbank_id = d.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(d.route) LIKE '%subcutaneous%'
    AND LOWER(d.form) LIKE '%powder%'
    AND LOWER(d.form) LIKE '%solution%'
)
SELECT strength
FROM filtered
ORDER BY numeric_mg DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH action AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT known_action AS action
  FROM "drugbank_transporters"
  WHERE known_action IS NOT NULL AND lower(known_action) LIKE '%transport%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT known_action
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE known_action IS NOT NULL AND lower(known_action) LIKE '%transport%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT known_action
  FROM "drugbank_carriers"
  WHERE known_action IS NOT NULL AND lower(known_action) LIKE '%transport%'
),
susp_drug_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages"
  WHERE form IS NOT NULL AND lower(form) LIKE '%suspension%'
),
zinc_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT left_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE left_drugbank_id IN (SELECT parent_key FROM susp_drug_ids)
    AND left_drugbank_name IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%zinc%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT right_drugbank_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE right_drugbank_id IN (SELECT parent_key FROM susp_drug_ids)
    AND right_drugbank_name IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%zinc%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT l.title
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  WHERE l.parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM susp_drug_ids)
    AND l.title IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%zinc%'
)

  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%textbook%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%handbook%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(url, '')) LIKE '%book%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(url, '')) LIKE '%isbn%'

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atc_code) AS cnt

  a.cnt AS unique_ahfs_pharmacologic_classification_codes,
  CASE WHEN t.cnt > a.cnt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_textbook_count_greater,
  CASE WHEN t.cnt > a.cnt THEN t.cnt - a.cnt ELSE 0 END AS difference_if_greater
FROM textbook_refs t, ahfs_codes a

  SELECT identifier AS pfam_id, parent_key AS polypeptide_parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams"

),
serum_carrier_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_key AS drugbank_id, sp.pfam_id
  FROM serum_pfam sp
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp
    ON cp.parent_id = sp.polypeptide_parent_id
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers" c
    ON c.id = cp.parent_id
)
